test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required'.

(I wouldn't cross him if I was you, not) if you value your life.

options.text: I wouldn't has crossed him if I were you, not
I wouldn't had crossed him if I was you, not
I wouldn't cross him if I were you, not

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. (I wouldn't cross him if I were you, not)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the bracketed segment is the use of 'was' instead of 'were' in the conditional clause 'if I were you'.
 
• Therefore, the corrected sentence should read, "I wouldn't cross him if I were you, not if you value your life."
 
• Therefore, Option 4 (I wouldn't cross him if I were you, not) is the correct substitution for the bracketed segment.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: "I wouldn't cross him if I were you, not if you value your life."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "I wouldn't has crossed him if I were you, not" - This is incorrect because 'has crossed' is the wrong verb form in this context.
 
• "I wouldn't had crossed him if I was you, not" - This option is incorrect because 'had crossed' is the wrong verb form and 'was' should be replaced with 'were'.
